_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Fits the grid after a burst of resizes (shrinking). The test seeded a conversation at /c/gh-resize-shrinking, whose directory holds t.sh, which prints "ghostty-ready" and then echoes what it reads. "The terminal" is '.terminal-panel-content [data-terminal-id][style*="display: block"]' and "the input" is [data-testid="message-input"]. To choose a terminal menu item, click the button with aria-label exactly "Terminal menu", then the button with exactly that text inside ".overflow-menu-panel" (two real clicks). "Read all output until it matches P" means: retry the following steps as one block until they pass (timeout 15s): fill the input with ""; choose the terminal menu item "Insert all output into input" (both clicks inside the block); the input's value must match P (eval with expect true). "Read the visible screen until it matches P" is the same with the menu item "Insert visible screen into input". "Set the theme to T" means what the theme menu does, the eval: localStorage.setItem("shelley-theme", "T"); document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", "T" === "dark"). "The handle" is ".terminal-panel-resize-handle". "The slack" is the eval (() => { const el = document.querySelector('.terminal-panel-content [data-terminal-id][style*="display: block"]'); return el.firstElementChild.getBoundingClientRect().height - el.querySelector("canvas").getBoundingClientRect().height; })().
1. Navigate to /c/gh-resize-shrinking. Fill the input with "!bash t.sh" and click [data-testid="send-button"].
2. Read all output until it contains "ghostty-ready".
3. Eval: const b = the handle's getBoundingClientRect(); window.__handle = {x: b.x + b.width / 2, y: b.y + b.height / 2, top: b.y}.
4. Drag the divider in a short burst, faster than ghostty-web's FitAddon accepts resizes: hover the point `({x: window.__handle.x, y: window.__handle.y})`, mouse_down, hover the point `({x: window.__handle.x, y: window.__handle.y + 180})` with count 3, mouse_up.
5. The handle's getBoundingClientRect().y should come to be within 0.5 of window.__handle.top + 180 (eval, expect true).
6. Within one row (about 17px) and not overflowing: the slack should become at least 0 (eval, expect true), and then the slack should become less than 20 (a second eval).
